黑洞与伴星: A black hole and its companion
恒星没有一下子消失，却有气体不断流向身边的黑洞。跟着一小团气体，看懂双星中的持续: The star remains, while gas keeps flowing toward its black hole companion. Follow a parcel to explore accretion in a binary system.
恒星为什么还在那里？: Why is the star still there?
大而发亮的是恒星，小黑点标记黑洞。这次恒星的外层还没有扩展到容易流出去的位置。: The large bright body is the star; the small dark marker is the black hole. The star’s outer layers have not expanded far enough to overflow.
有黑洞在身边，不等于气体一定不断掉进去。这里没有设置明显的气体转移。: Having a black hole nearby does not guarantee steady infall. This example has no substantial gas transfer.
恒星还在，黑洞也还在。它们可以共同绕行；是否喂养，还要看恒星的大小、间距和恒星风: Both objects remain in orbit. Feeding depends on the star’s size, their separation and the stellar wind.
这是分离双星的示意。圆轨道以共同质心为中心，距离按两者质量反比分配。画面取伴星与: This schematic detached binary has circular motion about its barycenter, with orbital distances inversely proportional to mass. The illustrative donor-to-black-hole mass ratio is 16:9 and does not identify a specific observed system.
围绕共同质心运动: Orbiting a shared center of mass
因为这里主要转移的是恒星外层的一部分气体，和“整颗恒星被潮汐撕碎”是不同的过程。: Only some outer gas is being transferred here. This differs from tidal disruption of an entire star. The small dark marker represents a stellar-mass black hole; that mass category does not mean weak gravity. A binary system is also distinct in scale from a galaxy’s central supermassive black hole.
两个天体按固定质量比绕共同质心做圆周运动。伴星参考范围用 Eggleton 等体: The two bodies move in circular orbits about their barycenter at a fixed mass ratio. The donor guide uses Eggleton’s approximate volume-equivalent Roche-lobe radius. Prescribed gas paths connect its surface continuously to the outer disk. Particles fade in and out to illustrate sustained supply; mass loss and black-hole growth are not calculated.
持续转移气体 · 恒星仍然存在: ONGOING GAS TRANSFER · THE STAR REMAINS
亮点追踪一小团气体；黑洞标记与盘的内侧单独放大，流速为示意。: The bright marker follows a parcel. The black hole and inner disk are enlarged separately; flow speed is illustrative.
恒星外层扩展得足够远时，靠近黑洞的一侧可以不断流出气体。看，大部分恒星仍然好好地: When the star’s outer layers expand far enough, gas can flow from the side facing the black hole. Most of the star is still there.
跟着亮点。离开的气体带着原来的运动，不会笔直掉入黑洞，而是弯成一条气流。: Follow the bright marker. The escaping gas carries its previous motion, so it follows a curved stream rather than dropping straight in.
气流接到黑洞周围的吸积盘上。盘里的物质一边绕行，一边相互作用，部分气体才能继续向: The stream joins an accretion disk. Interactions among orbiting gas allow some material to move farther inward.
内侧气体继续吸积，伴星又送来新的气体。这就是持续喂养的情景：外层在失去物质，整颗: Inner gas accretes as the companion supplies more. The star loses material from its outer layers without immediately disappearing.
这是洛希瓣溢流的示意：伴星接近其临界等势面时，气体可通过内拉格朗日点附近转移。公: This illustrates Roche-lobe overflow: near its critical equipotential surface, the donor can transfer gas through the vicinity of the inner Lagrange point. Orbital motion supplies angular momentum, allowing a disk to form; inward accretion requires angular-momentum transport. The dashed guide uses an approximate volume-equivalent Roche-lobe radius, not the actual equipotential surface.
先看恒星，再跟着亮点：物质从哪里出发，先到盘里，还是直接进入黑洞？: Find the star, then follow the marker: does its gas enter the disk first or fall straight into the black hole?
外层气体离开，伴星继续存在: Outer gas leaves while the companion remains
散开的淡色气体是恒星风；朝向黑洞的部分形成供给流。: The diffuse outward flow is stellar wind; a focused portion supplies the black hole.
有些恒星会把气体不断吹向周围，这叫恒星风。它不是空气，而是离开恒星的物质。: Some stars continuously drive gas outward in a stellar wind. This is escaping stellar material, not ordinary air.
黑洞可以捕获其中一部分。留意画面：不是所有风都转向黑洞，许多气体仍朝外散去。: The black hole can capture some of it. Not all the wind turns toward the black hole; much of it keeps flowing outward.
被捕获的气体可以在黑洞附近绕行、受热并吸积。宽宽的恒星风和集中的供给流同时存在。: Captured gas can orbit, heat up and accrete near the black hole. The broad wind and the focused supply coexist.
这也是持续喂养，不需要先把整颗恒星撕碎。天鹅座 X-1 就是恒星风供给黑洞的著名: This can sustain feeding without first shredding the whole star. Cygnus X-1 is a well-known example of wind-fed black-hole accretion.
恒星风吸积与洛希瓣溢流是不同的供给途径，也可能存在混合与聚焦流。天鹅座 X-1: Wind accretion and Roche-lobe overflow are distinct supply channels, with focused or mixed flows also possible. Cygnus X-1 is mainly fed by its supergiant companion’s stellar wind. Actual capture rates, wind acceleration and X-ray spectra are not calculated.
同时找两种去向：哪些气体朝远处走，哪些气体接近黑洞？: Find both outcomes: which gas goes outward, and which approaches the black hole?
天鹅座 X-1 是真实例子；画面的大小、质量比和气流路径并不是它的精确复原。: Cygnus X-1 is a real example; the displayed sizes, mass ratio and gas paths are not a precise reconstruction of it.
伴星逐渐失去外层物质。短短这段演示不会把恒星明显缩小；真实转移量与时间依具体系统: The companion gradually loses outer material. It does not visibly shrink over this short illustration; real transfer rates and timescales depend on the system.
双星与气流为教学示意，黑洞和盘的内侧单独放大。黑洞近景使用无自旋、薄盘假设下的简: The binary and gas flow are illustrative, with the black hole and inner disk enlarged separately. The close-up uses simplified ray integration for a non-spinning black hole and thin disk to show gravitational light bending; colors and brightness are not observed spectra. The star does not shrink with particle counts, and 32 seconds has no universal real-time equivalent.
亮带为什么会绕到黑洞上方？: Why does a bright band arch over the black hole?
发光的是黑洞外的热气体。引力会弯曲光的路径，使盘后方的光也来到我们眼前；吸积盘本: Hot gas outside the black hole emits the light. Gravity bends light from the far side toward us; the disk itself has not stood upright. Select the close-up, then rotate the view to compare the bright bands.
伴星和黑洞都在运动。在近似孤立的双星系统中，两者绕共同质心运行；质量较大的天体离: Both the donor star and black hole move. In an approximately isolated binary they orbit their common barycenter, with the more massive object closer to it. This illustration fixes masses and separation and uses circular orbits.
r_*、r_BH 是两者到质心的距离，a 为中心间距。这里质量比取 16:9，仅: r_* and r_BH are distances to the barycenter and a is the separation. The adopted 16:9 mass ratio is illustrative, not a fit to an observed system.
若关闭绕行，显示的是随双星转动的参考视图，不代表黑洞和伴星真的静止不动。: Turning off orbiting gives a co-rotating reference view; it does not mean the objects are stationary.
在双星共转参考系中，引力和离心项共同构成有效势。伴星接近填满洛希瓣时，外层气体可: In a binary’s co-rotating frame, gravity and the centrifugal term define an effective potential. Near Roche-lobe filling, outer gas can pass near the inner Lagrange point. An outward stellar wind provides a different supply route.
这是 Eggleton 的等体积洛希瓣半径近似，q = M_*/M_BH。实际洛: This is Eggleton’s volume-equivalent Roche-lobe-radius approximation, with q = M_*/M_BH. A real Roche lobe is not spherical; the dashed circle is a size reference, not a solid boundary.
切换只绕行、溢流和恒星风，比较物质从哪里出发，以及哪些部分靠近黑洞。: Compare detached, overflow and wind scenarios. Locate each material source and see which parts approach the black hole.
越过洛希瓣不等于越过事件视界；进入供给流与最终落入黑洞是不同阶段。: Crossing a Roche lobe is not crossing an event horizon; entering a transfer stream and falling into the black hole are different stages.
角动量为什么让气体先绕行: Why angular momentum makes gas orbit
流向黑洞的气体通常带有角动量，不能仅因引力很强就笔直落入。耗散可使流逐渐圆盘化；: Transferred gas generally carries angular momentum, so strong gravity alone does not make it plunge radially inward. Dissipation can circularize a stream, while further accretion requires outward angular-momentum transport or winds. Illustrative paths make this visible without calculating transport.
j 是相对黑洞的单位质量角动量。R_circ 为牛顿点质量势中相同 j 的圆轨道: j is specific angular momentum about the black hole. R_circ is the circular-orbit radius with the same j in a Newtonian point-mass potential, a reference estimate outside the relativistic inner region.
从供给流跟随一个亮点，注意它先绕进盘，而不是一下子直线消失。: Follow a bright point from the stream and notice how it enters an orbiting disk before moving inward.
流线由连续路径构造，不是磁流体计算；画面的内移速度不能当作真实吸积时标。: Continuous constructed paths are not a magnetohydrodynamic solution; their inward speed is not a physical accretion timescale.
外部气体发光，伴星持续供给: External gas radiates while the donor supplies it
吸积释放引力束缚能，其中一部分转为辐射，亮光来自视界外的气体。伴星只逐渐失去外层: Accretion releases gravitational binding energy, some of which becomes radiation from gas outside the horizon. The donor loses outer material gradually and remains visible in this short illustration. Supply rate, inner accretion rate and luminosity need not track one another directly.
L 为辐射功率，Ṁ 为内区吸积率，η 为辐射效率；效率依吸积状态和黑洞性质而变。: L is radiative power, Ṁ inner accretion rate and η radiative efficiency, which depends on accretion state and black-hole properties. Displayed colors and particle counts are not calibrated to them.
选择黑洞近景，再回到系统全景，确认发光气体和仍在供给的伴星处在什么位置。: Compare the black-hole close-up and system view to locate luminous gas and the surviving donor.
视界外的光线可以被引力弯曲；不是黑洞把已经吞入的物质和光重新吐出来。: Gravity can bend light from outside the horizon; the black hole is not ejecting matter or light that already crossed it.
容易混淆的地方: A distinction to keep in mind
这次没有设置明显的供气。恒星与黑洞可以保持双星关系，并不因为靠近黑洞，就一定有大: No substantial gas supply is shown in this case. A star and black hole can remain a binary without large transfer merely because they are nearby. Switch to overflow or stellar wind to compare how transfer begins.
吸积释放引力束缚能，其中一部分转为辐射，亮光来自视界外的气体。在持续供给的情景中: Accretion releases gravitational binding energy, some of which becomes radiation from gas outside the horizon. In the supplying scenarios, the donor loses outer material gradually and remains visible in this short illustration. Supply rate, inner accretion rate and luminosity need not track one another directly.
